map.name: Dynasty Realism World Map
map.note: Shared canonical base map. Every playable's own map image (data/raw/<slug>/images/*.png) is a re-render of THIS terrain with that species' territories highlighted, so one normalized coordinate set aligns across all of them.
map.tracing: Area outlines traced from the black POI borders of the stacked profile maps (server/scripts/trace-regions.mjs). Landmark points remain approximate.

moistureMeaning.semi-arid: Dry-leaning scrub, hills or badlands with scarce water
moistureMeaning.wet: Marsh, bog, floodplain, river or lake shore

vocabulary.ecosystemsMeaning: Landscape of a POI area, using the ecosystem ids of data/reference/ecosystems.json. The first entry is the area's main character; a second one is a strong secondary trait (e.g. Dry Fang Canyon is arid and cliffy). Open fresh water outside these areas comes from data/map/layers/freshwater.png.

landscapes.label: Sea & Coast
landscapes.description: Open ocean, reefs, beaches, sea stacks and the coastal strip where the sea shapes daily life.

landscapes.label: Rivers, Lakes & Swamps
landscapes.description: Rivers, lakes, bogs, mudflats and riverbanks: life organised around fresh water.

landscapes.label: Forest
landscapes.description: Redwoods, jungle, woodland clearings and forested hills: cover, ambush and territory.

landscapes.label: Plains & Savanna
landscapes.description: Open country where the big herds migrate and the hunters follow them.

landscapes.label: Desert & Canyons
landscapes.description: Dry canyons, scrub, oases and salt rocks: heat, scarce water and long distances.

landscapes.label: Mountains & Cliffs
landscapes.description: Cliffs, ledges, caves and rocky outcrops in the high hills.
